User.title: User
User.description: Represents a staff user with access to the application, distinct from workers. Authentication data is managed externally by Firebase Auth.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: Email address of the user, primarily used for authentication.

displayName.description: The full name or display name of the user.

roleId.description: Reference to the Role entity that defines the user's permissions and access level. (Relationship: Role 1:N User)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was last updated.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Defines a system role with a specific set of permissions and access levels within the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Role entity.

name.description: The human-readable name of the role (e.g., 'system_admin', 'hr_manager').

description.description: A detailed description of the role's responsibilities and access.

Position.title: Position
Position.description: Represents a specific job position or role for workers, defining its general requirements.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Position entity.

name.description: The name of the position (e.g., 'Offshore Rigger', 'Welder').

description.description: A detailed description of the position's responsibilities.

CertificateType.title: CertificateType
CertificateType.description: A master list of available certificate types that workers can hold or positions can require.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CertificateType entity.

name.description: The name of the certificate type (e.g., 'BOSIET', 'First Aid', 'H2S').

description.description: A brief description of what the certificate entails.

recommendedValidityYears.description: The typical or recommended validity period for this certificate type in years, used for readiness calculation.

PositionCertificateRequirement.title: PositionCertificateRequirement
PositionCertificateRequirement.description: Defines a specific certificate requirement for a particular position.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PositionCertificateRequirement entity.

positionId.description: Reference to the Position entity this requirement belongs to. (Relationship: Position 1:N PositionCertificateRequirement)

certificateTypeId.description: Reference to the CertificateType entity being required. (Relationship: CertificateType 1:N PositionCertificateRequirement)

isRequired.description: Indicates whether this certificate is mandatory for the position.

validityYearsOverride.description: An optional override for the recommended validity years from the CertificateType for this specific position requirement.

description.description: Additional context or details about this specific certificate requirement for the position.

PpeType.title: PpeType
PpeType.description: A master list of available Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) types.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PpeType entity.

name.description: The name of the PPE type (e.g., 'Safety Helmet', 'Safety Boots').

description.description: A brief description of the PPE item.

unitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measure for this PPE item (e.g., 'pair', 'piece').

PositionPpeRequirement.title: PositionPpeRequirement
PositionPpeRequirement.description: Defines a specific PPE requirement for a particular position.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PositionPpeRequirement entity.

positionId.description: Reference to the Position entity this requirement belongs to. (Relationship: Position 1:N PositionPpeRequirement)

ppeTypeId.description: Reference to the PpeType entity being required. (Relationship: PpeType 1:N PositionPpeRequirement)

quantity.description: The quantity of this PPE item required for the position.

description.description: Additional context or details about this specific PPE requirement for the position.

ToolType.title: ToolType
ToolType.description: A master list of available tool types.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ToolType entity.

name.description: The name of the tool type (e.g., 'Wrench Set', 'Grinder').

description.description: A brief description of the tool item.

unitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measure for this tool item (e.g., 'set', 'unit').

PositionToolRequirement.title: PositionToolRequirement
PositionToolRequirement.description: Defines a specific tool requirement for a particular position.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PositionToolRequirement entity.

positionId.description: Reference to the Position entity this requirement belongs to. (Relationship: Position 1:N PositionToolRequirement)

toolTypeId.description: Reference to the ToolType entity being required. (Relationship: ToolType 1:N PositionToolRequirement)

quantity.description: The quantity of this tool item required for the position.

description.description: Additional context or details about this specific tool requirement for the position.

Worker.title: Worker
Worker.description: Represents an offshore or onshore worker, distinct from staff users. Stores personal details and current assignment status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Worker entity.

contactEmail.description: The worker's contact email address, primarily for notifications.

contactPhone.description: The worker's primary contact phone number.

currentPositionId.description: Reference to the Position entity that represents the worker's primary assigned position. (Relationship: Position 1:N Worker)

status.description: The current status of the worker (e.g., 'active', 'inactive', 'on-assignment').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the worker record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the worker record was last updated.

WorkerCertificate.title: WorkerCertificate
WorkerCertificate.description: Records a specific certificate held by a worker, including its validity and associated documentation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkerCertificate entity.

workerId.description: Reference to the Worker entity who holds this certificate. (Relationship: Worker 1:N WorkerCertificate)

certificateTypeId.description: Reference to the CertificateType entity representing the type of certificate. (Relationship: CertificateType 1:N WorkerCertificate)

issueDate.description: The date when the certificate was issued.

expiryDate.description: The date when the certificate will expire.

documentUrl.description: URL to the scanned copy or digital document of the certificate, stored in Firebase Storage.

status.description: The current validity status of the certificate (e.g., 'valid', 'expired', 'pending_renewal').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this certificate record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this certificate record was last updated.

WorkerMedicalRecord.title: WorkerMedicalRecord
WorkerMedicalRecord.description: Records a worker's medical examination results and their validity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkerMedicalRecord entity.

workerId.description: Reference to the Worker entity this medical record belongs to. (Relationship: Worker 1:N WorkerMedicalRecord)

recordDate.description: The date when the medical examination was conducted.

expiryDate.description: The date when this medical record expires.

description.description: A summary or general notes about the medical examination results.

documentUrl.description: URL to the scanned copy or digital document of the medical record, stored in Firebase Storage.

status.description: The fitness status of the worker based on this record (e.g., 'fit_for_duty', 'unfit', 'pending').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this medical record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this medical record was last updated.

WorkerDrugTest.title: WorkerDrugTest
WorkerDrugTest.description: Records a worker's drug test results and associated documentation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkerDrugTest entity.

workerId.description: Reference to the Worker entity this drug test belongs to. (Relationship: Worker 1:N WorkerDrugTest)

testDate.description: The date when the drug test was conducted.

result.description: The outcome of the drug test (e.g., 'pass', 'fail', 'pending').

documentUrl.description: URL to the scanned copy or digital document of the drug test result, stored in Firebase Storage.

description.description: Any additional comments or details regarding the drug test.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this drug test record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this drug test record was last updated.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Records all significant create, update, and delete operations within the application for audit purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AuditLog entry.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity who performed the action. (Relationship: User 1:N AuditLog)

entityType.description: The type of data entity that was affected by the action (e.g., 'Worker', 'Position').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity that was affected by the action.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the action occurred.

details.description: Optional details about the change, such as old and new values for updates, or specific context.

ipAddress.description: The IP address from which the action was initiated.

PayrollPeriod.title: PayrollPeriod
PayrollPeriod.description: Defines a specific window of time for payroll processing and cost allocation.

startDate.description: The start date of the period (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: The end date of the period (YYYY-MM-DD).

generatedBy.description: UID or name of the user who generated this period.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the period was generated.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore data structure emphasizes Authorization Independence and Structural Segregation to ensure robust, debuggable security rules and efficient query capabilities. All documents within a collection share a homogeneous security posture, eliminating the need to mix different access levels (e.g., public/private) within the same collection.

Authorization Independence is primarily achieved through hierarchical path-based ownership for subcollections. For instance, `worker_certificates` are nested under `workers/{workerId}/certificates/{workerCertificateId}`. This structure places the `workerId` directly in the document's path, making it readily available for security rules without requiring a `get()` operation to a parent `worker` document. This allows for atomic write operations involving both parent and child documents and simplifies rule logic considerably, as rules only need to check the path parameters and the requesting user's role.

For top-level collections (e.g., `users`, `roles`, `positions`, `workers`, `audit_logs`, and master data like `certificate_types`, `ppe_types`, `tool_types`), access control is managed via a Database Access Control (DBAC) model. Each staff `User` document (`/users/{userId}`) explicitly stores their `roleId`. Firebase Security Rules will leverage `request.auth.uid` to fetch the current user's role from their dedicated `/users/$(request.auth.uid)` document. Once the user's role is established, it is used to determine read/write/list permissions across the various top-level and subcollections. This avoids `get()` calls to other user documents for authorization.

Queryability and Authorization Performance (QAPs) are supported by ensuring that security rules are not used as filters. Each collection or subcollection is designed with explicit read/list permissions for defined roles. When a `list` operation is performed (as hinted by the error), the rules will either grant or deny access to the entire collection based on the user's role, without expecting client-side queries to filter unauthorized documents. This design allows for direct and efficient `list` operations without privacy leaks or unexpected data filtering by the rules. For example, `hr_manager` would be granted `list` access to `/workers`, meaning they can query and retrieve all worker documents directly.

The error reported in the user request, "Missing or insufficient permissions: The following request was denied by Firestore Security Rules: { "method": "list", "path": "/databases/(default)/documents/[CollectionGroup]" }", indicates a lack of `list` permission for the authenticated user on a specific collection or a collection group. The proposed structure, with clearly defined top-level collections and subcollections, combined with role-based access logic implemented using the `getUserRole` function in security rules, will explicitly grant `list` access where appropriate for each role (e.g., `sales_officer` for `customers`, `hr_manager` for `workers`). This will resolve the `list` permission error by aligning data access with the defined roles and permissions for each collection.
